content.text: Both files reviewed in full. Changes are purely presentational: CSS class tweaks, hardcoded inline `borderBottom` style values (no interpolation of user input), text/spacing edits to a heading and paragraph, and an added comment. No new sinks, no new data flow, no auth/validation logic touched. `onSearch`/`onPick`/`geoError` handling is unchanged in behavior — `geoError` was already rendered as text in the same location.
